tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground and the `.g-paper` sheet. Dark is the default theme. Text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: The `.g-panel` sheet, feature panels, chain steps, select option backgrounds. Text on it is `ink`.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All text on `paper` and `panel` (15.6:1 both themes). Secondary text is `muted`, never a new grey. Hover inverts: ink becomes ground.

tokens.name: contrast
tokens.usage: The `.g-contrast` sheet. Always dark: full ink in the light theme, graphite in dark so it never glares. Text on it is `contrast-ink`.

tokens.name: contrast-ink
tokens.usage: Text on `contrast` (10.9:1 on graphite, 15.6:1 on ink) and on `code`.

tokens.name: signal
tokens.usage: The one signal. Primary button fill, the signal pixel, the redaction bar, Critical, the focus ring. Never moves between themes. One full `.g-signal` sheet per page at most. Not for text on paper: use `acc-ink`.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text and pixels on `signal` (5.6:1). Also the focus ring inside a `.g-signal` sheet.

tokens.name: acc-ink
tokens.usage: Signal as text: on `paper` and `panel` it is #C42A0B (4.6:1) in light and #FF6647 (6.4:1) in dark. Link hover, sort arrows, the ✖ in comparison tables, field errors.

tokens.name: contrast-acc
tokens.usage: Signal as text on `contrast` and `code` (6.4:1 on #2E2D29).

tokens.name: code
tokens.usage: Code block ground, both themes. Text on it is `contrast-ink`; keywords `contrast-acc`.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Every hairline on `paper` and `panel`: rules, table borders, 1px frames, tag borders at rest. Ink at 16%. Rules that open a list are full `ink`.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `paper` and `panel`: labels, captions, table heads, footer copy. Ink at 66% (6.6:1 dark, 7.1:1 light).

tokens.name: tint
tokens.usage: Data-table row hover and status-line hover on `paper` and `panel`. Rows tint; index rows invert.

tokens.name: contrast-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines on `contrast` and `code`.

tokens.name: contrast-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on `contrast` (7.2:1 on graphite).

tokens.name: contrast-tint
tokens.usage: Row hover on `contrast`.

tokens.name: signal-line
tokens.usage: Hairlines on a `.g-signal` sheet.

tokens.name: signal-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on a `.g-signal` sheet.

tokens.name: signal-tint
tokens.usage: Row hover on a `.g-signal` sheet.

tokens.name: logo-orange
tokens.usage: The orange inside the supplied logo files only (`assets/Logos`). It is not `signal`; never use it in UI, and never recolour the mark to `signal`.

families.mono: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: stair
styles.usage: The S4 stair headline on the home and Labs landing: three lines indented 2em, 1em, 0. Fluid: min((100cqw - 2*pad) / 12.6, 128px).

styles.name: h-page
styles.usage: Page banner title. Fluid: clamp(40px, 6.4cqw, 104px). Always flush left; may carry one redacted word (S3) on the home hero only.

styles.name: h-sheet
styles.usage: Sheet (section) headline. Fluid: clamp(36px, 5.6cqw, 96px). A second clause at `dim` opacity, never a second colour.

styles.name: h-util
styles.usage: Compact banner title on listing and data pages (A1). Fluid: clamp(32px, 4cqw, 60px).

styles.name: h-title
styles.usage: Feature panel and block titles. Fluid: clamp(26px, 3.3cqw, 48px).

styles.name: h-block
styles.usage: Sub-block heading inside a sheet; prose h2. Fluid: clamp(24px, 2.4cqw, 34px).

styles.name: irow-title
styles.usage: Index row title. Fluid: clamp(22px, 2.2cqw, 30px).

styles.name: cap-title
styles.usage: Title in a capability row (icon, title, text).

styles.name: num
styles.usage: Numbers and ledgers at Archivo width 62: font-variation-settings 'wdth' 62. Stat rows, years, CVE numbers. Fluid: clamp(30px, 4.4cqw, 72px).

styles.name: lede
styles.sample: Agentic unified cybersecurity platform that separates the signal from the noise.
styles.usage: Banner subtitle and the paragraph beside a sheet headline. Max 46ch. Fluid: clamp(17px, 1.45cqw, 21px).

styles.name: body-l
styles.sample: K7 Seventh Sense goes beyond the obvious to understand security.
styles.usage: Feature panel copy, step lists, facts.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Prevention, detection, and response across your IT ecosystem.
styles.usage: Running copy, capability row text. Prose pages use 18px/1.65.

styles.name: body-s
styles.sample: Real-time and scheduled monitoring of files and directories.
styles.usage: Footer links, table cells, report descriptions, form copy.

styles.name: nav
styles.usage: Header navigation links. Current item underlined 2px in `ink`.

styles.name: btn
styles.usage: Button label. Small buttons 13px.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: Type-set wordmark beside the signal square when the logo file is not used; Archivo width 112.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase. Sheet tabs, eyebrows, table heads, footer column heads, form labels. `muted` unless it is a signal label (`acc-ink`).

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Uppercase. Tags, compliance pills, module chips. 1px border in currentColor, 4px 8px padding.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Dates, versions and hashes in tables. Dates DD-MM-YYYY.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Values in meta rows and spec strips: phone numbers, IDs, counts.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Uppercase. Figure captions inside a 1px frame, copy buttons.

tokens.name: pad
tokens.usage: Page gutter: clamp(20px, 2.8cqw, 40px). Every sheet, header and footer uses it.

tokens.name: sheet-top
tokens.usage: Sheet padding-top: clamp(56px, 7cqw, 112px).

tokens.name: sheet-bottom
tokens.usage: Sheet padding-bottom: clamp(72px, 8cqw, 128px).

tokens.name: tab-w
tokens.usage: Sheet tab width (13.5rem). Tabs step right to left down the page.

tokens.name: tab-h
tokens.usage: Sheet tab and research tab height (42px on the research bar).

tokens.name: header-h
tokens.usage: Site header bar height. 64px on the home page.

tokens.name: btn-h
tokens.usage: Button height; 36px for `.btn-sm`.

tokens.name: row-y
tokens.usage: Index row padding-block; capability rows 26px; table cells 16px.

tokens.name: gap-s
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons, tags and icon-to-label.

tokens.name: gap-m
tokens.usage: Gap between row columns and in header.

tokens.name: gap-l
tokens.usage: Gap between sheet head and body; footer columns clamp(32px, 5cqw, 80px).

tokens.name: pixel
tokens.usage: The signal pixel in tabs, stamps and tags. 3px inside a 32px icon.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Icon grid. 48px in capability rows, 40px in compact banners.

tokens.name: measure-lede
tokens.usage: Max width of a lede.

tokens.name: measure-prose
tokens.usage: Max width of the prose column.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: The only radius. No rounded corners anywhere; the cut (see Cut) is the corner treatment.

cut.note: S2 · The cut, top-right only, taken from the stroke of the 7. Applied as clip-path: polygon(0 0, calc(100% - N) 0, 100% N, 100% 100%, 0 100%). Everything else is square.

tokens.name: cut-tab
tokens.usage: Sheet tabs and research tabs.

tokens.name: cut-btn
tokens.usage: Primary and ink buttons.

tokens.name: cut-feature
tokens.usage: Featured panels and the report cover (9% of its width).

tokens.name: dim
tokens.usage: The second clause of a sheet headline.

tokens.name: quiet
tokens.usage: Header labels, hero meta, figure captions.

tokens.name: pattern-min
tokens.usage: Seven hatch (PT2) ink.

tokens.name: pattern-mid
tokens.usage: Registration grid (PT1) ink.

tokens.name: pattern-max
tokens.usage: Dot field (PT3) ink, only inside figure frames.

tokens.name: disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled buttons and pager ends.
